info.title: API-DocTest-List Airline Flights Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Status Information API provides real-time updates on the status of airline flights, allowing users to access crucial details such as departure and arrival times, delays, and cancellations. This API is designed for travel agencies, airlines, and application developers who need to present accurate flight information to their customers. By integrating this API, users can enhance their offerings with timely data that improves passenger experience and operational efficiency. Use cases include travel planning tools, mobile applications for travelers, and airport display systems.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a flight.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of a specific flight. Users can find out if the flight is on time, delayed, or canceled, along with relevant details such as departure and arrival times.
